title: Israeli Strike Kills Newlywed Woman in Arab Salim, Wounds Six
detail: An Israeli airstrike hit a house in the southern town of Arab Salim (Nabatieh district), killing a woman who Lebanon's National News Agency said had been married for 48 hours; her home was destroyed. Lebanon's Ministry of Health said six people were wounded in the strikes, including a child, a woman, and two elderly people. The Israeli military said it targeted Hezbollah 'weapon storage facilities' in response to Hezbollah launching two explosive drones overnight at Israeli soldiers operating on the Ali al-Taher ridge; Israeli forces shot down one of the drones. Israeli strikes and demolitions also hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Kfar Rumman, al-Mansouri, Mayfadoun, Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh, and Mays al-Jabal overnight.

title: Next Round of Lebanon-Israel Rome Talks Set for Second Half of September
detail: An informed source said Lebanon and Israel will hold their next round of US-brokered negotiations in Rome during the second half of September, with Lebanon hoping to resume work on the 'pilot zones' for Israeli withdrawal and Lebanese army deployment. US Ambassador Michel Issa had previously described the talks as technical in nature, continuing without a fixed timeline. Two prior rounds were hosted at the US Embassy in Rome, in July and August 2026, following the framework agreement signed in Washington in late June.

media.caption: Lebanon and Israel to hold next round of Rome talks in September 2026
